COMPRESS::buffer_size
Description
Sets the compression buffer size.
Syntax
COMPRESS
::
buffer_size
<
value
>
COMPRESS::buffer_size <value>
Sets the compression buffer size according to the value you specify
in bytes.
Examples
when
HTTP_RESPONSE
{
if
{
[
HTTP
::
header
Content-Type
]
contains
"text/html;charset=UTF-8"
}
{
COMPRESS
::
buffer_size
10240
COMPRESS
::
enable
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
HTTP_REQUEST
,
HTTP_REQUEST_DATA
,
HTTP_RESPONSE
